title: Merchandise Purchases Sales Tax Charged on the Part a Finch Note Paid
content:
**Rule.** When a note recorded as redeemed on a Merchandise Purchases purchase record was left undeducted at the register, the unit was charged sales tax on the part of its price the note had already paid; with the correction this policy refunds the tax recorded on that part, apportioned the way price adjustments apportion tax.

**Scope.** For sales tax charged on the part a Finch Note paid, where the note was recorded as redeemed on a unit but left undeducted, that this policy handles, and only for such tax, the register-error adjustment is still made at any time while the unit is not returned and still counts toward no limit, and it refunds that tax together with the tax service credit and goodwill; every other register error, including a unit rung above its shelf ticket; registry credit recorded as spent but left undeducted; the card money taken for a Finch Note recorded as redeemed but left undeducted; gift card or Bonus Card value recorded as redeemed but left undeducted; and a second capture of the same tender, stays under the base rule or the rule written for it.

**What the correction does and does not touch.** The refund goes to the unit's original tender and the correction records no new unit price; the note itself and the money taken for its part are not dealt with here.

## Basis Q&A

- *What is refunded?* The sales tax recorded on the part of the price the note had paid, together with the tax service credit and goodwill.
- *To where?* The unit's original tender.
- *Is the card money taken for the note's part refunded by this correction?* No; this correction deals only with the tax.
- *Is the note reinstated?* No; the note itself is not dealt with here.
- *Is there a deadline?* The correction is made at any time while the unit is not returned, and counts toward no limit.

## Booking the refund — `refund_note_tax_482f19cd`

**Capability.** Books a Finch Note tax refund on one purchase record: a register-error price adjustment that returns the sales tax charged on the part of the unit a redeemed Finch Note had paid, together with any credits owed for it. On success one price adjustment entry with the current date and the reason register price error is added to the unit's records, with no new unit price; the amount goes back to the tender the unit was paid with, and the unit's amount paid and not refunded goes down by the same amount. The note itself is not changed. The customer sees the refund on the original tender.

**How it is invoked.** `refund_note_tax_482f19cd` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**
- `purchase_id` — the reference number of the purchase record (one unit of one item) the Finch Note was redeemed on, as returned by the purchase lookup for this customer; identifier text.
- `amount` — the total refunded by this entry; USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed; never empty.

Neither parameter takes an enumerated value.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new price adjustment reference number (an opaque text reference), the purchase record reference number, the amount refunded (USD, 2 decimal places), the tender refunded, and the unit's remaining amount paid and not refunded (USD, 2 decimal places). A sentence starting with "Finch Note tax refund booked" means the entry was recorded.
